meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 把 Emacs 接成一个通道:Claude 在 Emacs 里开聊天 buffer,也能接收当前 org 子树或选中区域,回复以子标题形式写回原文件。
howto.when: 用 Doom、Spacemacs 或 vanilla Emacs(27.1+)按键打开聊天 buffer,或在 org 文件里对某标题执行 nanoclaw-org-send 时,消息经由本地 HTTP 桥接发给 Claude。

howto.what_en: Adds Emacs as a channel over a local HTTP bridge. Claude opens a chat buffer inside Emacs and can also receive the current org subtree or region, with replies landing as child headings in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer by keybinding in Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla Emacs 27.1+, or run nanoclaw-org-send on a heading in an org file.

say_en.text: Explain the code my cursor is on
say_en.note: Sent with nanoclaw-org-send; reply becomes a child heading

say_en.text: Turn these meeting notes into an action item list
say_en.note: Reply is written back as a child heading in the org file

say_en.text: What does this error message mean?
say_en.note: Type in the chat buffer and press C-c C-c to send
